title: The Best of Denver: E-Bike & Bicycle Tour of the Downtown Sites
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
No infant seats or carriers available
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join a knowledgeable local tour guide who will guide you on your own bicycle safely through downtown Denver's most important and relevant tourist sights including historic buildings, architectural masterpieces, professional sports stadiums, scores of public art installations, parks and outdoor venues.  Groups are small, 2-16 people with a guide to guest ratio of 1:8 Duration of tour is 2.5 hours and approximately 9 miles. E-bikes available with limited availability.
